# Vendored pdf.js

`pdf.min.mjs` and `pdf.worker.min.mjs` are the unmodified `build/` files from `pdfjs-dist` 6.5.438
(https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js), licensed under Apache 2.0. See `LICENSE`.

To update, run `npm pack pdfjs-dist@<version>` in an empty directory, extract it, and copy those two
files and `LICENSE` here.
